name: 4a-mods
description: 4A-Mods: Claude Code mods by 4AM. Cache Keeper shows costs as plan-limit percent instead of dollars; Toggles switches plugins, skills and MCP servers and shows what each costs in context; Plan Keeper ticks plan files from the task list; Prompt Translate turns your draft into English with one button; Connector Trim shortens big MCP connector results by code and Haiku and saves the full result to a file.

plugins.name: cache-keeper
plugins.description: Keeps a big chat's prompt cache warm, warns before an expensive cold restart, shows every local chat on one board (/board), and hands a chat off to a fresh one (/handoff)

plugins.name: plugin-toggles
plugins.description: One pane (/toggles) to switch skills On, Name, User or Off, plugins and MCP servers On or Off, see what each costs in context, and save the set as a profile

plugins.name: plan-keeper
plugins.description: Ticks a plan file's checkbox items once the task-list step of the same text is done, and lists the open items when a chat starts or clears

plugins.name: prompt-translate
plugins.description: An EN button above the prompt (or /translate) that has Haiku translate your draft into English in place, without sending it

plugins.name: connector-trim
plugins.description: Trims big MCP (connector) results by code, has Haiku condense what is still big for the task, and saves the full result to a file (/connector-trim)
